tool.name: 3D-Beacons API
tool.description: The 3D-Beacons Network provides unified programmatic access to experimentally determined and predicted structure models
tool.command: mkdir -p 'output_dir/' && python3 '$__tool_directory__/api_wrapper_3dbeacons.py' #if $mode == 'single' single '$qualifier' output_dir #if $provider --provider '$provider' #end if #if $exclude_provider --exclude-provider '$exclude_provider' #end if #if $template --template '$template' #end if #if $sequence_range --sequence-range '$sequence_range' #end if #if $uniprot_checksum --uniprot-checksum '$uniprot_checksum' #end if #else batch '$tsv_file' output_dir #end if

param.name: provider
param.label: Provider
param.help: Request from provider only. If no provider is selected, query all providers.

param.name: template
param.label: Template structure
param.help: Template PDB ID (4-character code, e.g., '1ake', or with chain/assembly like '1ake.1.A').

validator.message: Template must be a 4-character PDB ID (e.g., '1ake') optionally followed by assembly and chain (e.g., '1ake.1.A', '1ake1A').

param.name: sequence_range
param.label: Sequence range
param.help: Specify a UniProt sequence residue range (format: 'start-end', e.g., '1-100').

validator.message: Sequence range must be in format 'start-end' (e.g., '1-100')

param.name: uniprot_checksum
param.label: UniProt checksum
param.help: CRC64 checksum of the UniProt sequence (16-character hex value, e.g., '1A2B3C4D5E6F7890').

validator.message: UniProt checksum must be a 16-character hexadecimal value (e.g., '1A2B3C4D5E6F7890')

param.name: tsv_file
param.label: TSV query file
param.help: Tab-separated file with columns: 'qualifier' column and optional parameter columns

tool.help:
The 3D-Beacons API tool provides unified access to experimentally determined and predicted protein structure models from multiple providers via the `3D-Beacons Network API <https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pdbe/pdbe-kb/3dbeacons/>`_.
Single Query Mode -----------------
Use single query mode to fetch all available structure models for one protein (UniProt entry). This mode is ideal for exploring structural data for individual proteins.
**Parameters:**
- **Qualifier**: UniProt accession or identifier (e.g., ``P12345``) - **Provider**: Optional filter to request models from one provider only - **Exclude Provider**: Optional filter to exclude one provider from results - **Template**: Optional filter by template PDB ID (4-character code, e.g., ``1ake`` or with chain/assembly like ``1ake.1.A``) - **Sequence Range**: Optional filter by UniProt sequence range (format: ``start-end``, e.g., ``1-100``) - **UniProt Checksum**: Optional filter by CRC64 checksum (16-character hex value)
Batch Query Mode ----------------
Use batch mode to process multiple proteins in one tool run. This mode is **required for Galaxy workflows** processing multiple inputs.
**Activating Batch Mode in Workflows:**
When using this tool in a workflow, click on the tool node to open its settings, then change the "Search Request" parameter from "Single query" to "Batch query". This switches the tool to batch mode and reveals the TSV file input. You can then connect a TSV dataset or dataset collection from a previous workflow step.
**TSV File Format:**
The input file must be tab-separated with a header row. The ``qualifier`` column is required. Optional parameter columns are: ``provider``, ``exclude_provider``, ``template``, ``sequence_range``, ``uniprot_checksum``. Lines starting with ``#`` are treated as comments and ignored.
**Example TSV file:**
::
# Example 3D-Beacons batch query qualifier provider template sequence_range P04637 alphafold P00533 pdbe 1m17 P00921 50-150 Q9H222
This example queries:
- All providers for P04637 (p53) from AlphaFold DB - PDBe models for P00533 (EGFR) with template 1m17 - All providers for P12345 restricted to sequence range 50-150 - All providers for Q9H222
Available Providers -------------------
The following providers are available through 3D-Beacons:
- SWISS-MODEL - ModelArchive - AlphaFill - AlphaFold DB - HegeLab - PDBe - Protein Ensemble Database (PED) - SASBDB
Output Format -------------
Output file formats (PDB or `mmCIF <https://mmcif.wwpdb.org>`_/ `ModelCIF <https://mmcif.wwpdb.org/dictionaries/mmcif_ma.dic/Index/>`_) are determined by the individual providers, not by the 3D-Beacons API. The tool downloads models in the native format provided by each structure provider.
**Output Structure:**
Single mode outputs are organized into collections:
- **Models by provider**: mmCIF/ ModelCIF or PDB coordinate files grouped by provider - **Model summaries**: JSON files with per-model metadata (one per model) - **Entry information**: JSON file with UniProt entry metadata
Batch mode outputs are organized as nested collections by qualifier, with the same internal structure (models, summaries, entry info) for each query.
Attribution -----------
When using data from 3D-Beacons, please cite the 3D-Beacons publication and acknowledge the individual data providers according to their terms of use.
